hypothesis: We can build a team overview bundle by combining four Pulselive endpoints (core team data, team form, next fixture, and metadata) that all work unauthenticated via GET.
rationale: Network exploration lists high-interest endpoints for team 1 in competition 8, season 2025: /api/v2/teams/{teamId}, /api/v1/competitions/8/seasons/2025/teamform, /api/v1/competitions/8/seasons/2025/teams/{teamId}/form, /api/v1/competitions/8/seasons/2025/teams/{teamId}/nextfixture, and /api/v1/metadata/SDP_FOOTBALL_TEAM/{teamId}. We need to confirm they are callable from the browser context and return JSON so we can chain them in one routine.
prompt:
You are investigating Pulselive team-related APIs from a Premier League page.

1. Use browser_navigate to https://www.premierleague.com/en/clubs/1/manchester-united/overview and wait for load.
2. Using browser_eval_js with fetch(), test these GET endpoints one by one, parsing response.json():
   a) https://sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com/api/v2/teams/1
   b) https://sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com/api/v1/competitions/8/seasons/2025/teamform
   c) https://sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com/api/v1/competitions/8/seasons/2025/teams/1/form
   d) https://sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com/api/v1/competitions/8/seasons/2025/teams/1/nextfixture
   e) https://sdp-prem-prod.premier-league-prod.pulselive.com/api/v1/metadata/SDP_FOOTBALL_TEAM/1
3. If any fetch() call fails with TypeError: Failed to fetch or a CORS issue, retry that URL by navigating directly to it with browser_navigate and then using browser_eval_js('document.body.innerText') + JSON.parse to inspect the JSON.
4. For each endpoint, report: whether it succeeded, method used (fetch vs navigate), HTTP status if visible, and a sample of top-level JSON keys.
5. Summarize which endpoints are safe to combine into a single unauthenticated "team overview" bundle routine parameterized by competitionId, seasonId, and teamId.

summary.teamOverviewBundleAssessment: Given that fetch() is failing for all tested Pulselive APIs from the club page context, these endpoints cannot currently be combined into a single unauthenticated client-side bundle using fetch from premierleague.com. However, the endpoints do appear to be directly browsable, so they may be usable from a server-side routine or as direct navigations. Among the tested endpoints, the metadata endpoint (e) is confirmed to return unauthenticated JSON suitable for a team overview (club_established, stadium, website, social handles, shirt URLs). The other endpoints (a–d) likely also return unauthenticated JSON (team info, competition-wide team form, specific team form, next fixture) but this could not be verified via JSON inspection due to the fetch failures and lack of captured bodies.
summary.safeToBundleUnauthenticated: Conservatively, only endpoint (e) can be confirmed as safely usable for an unauthenticated team overview bundle based on observed JSON. Endpoints (a–d) appear reachable via direct navigation but their JSON structure and access characteristics (e.g., rate limiting, additional headers) are not observable from this environment, so they should be treated as unverified for a generic unauthenticated bundle routine parameterized by competitionId, seasonId, and teamId.
